text:
Minoh Falls and Katsuo-ji, the temple of a thousand daruma, are 80 minutes apart on foot, and since March 2025 no bus links them. The fix is simple: do the day backwards 👇

🤔 Guess which direction saves your legs, then check 👉 https://japanbystation.com/minoh-falls-to-katsuoji-walk-or-bus

We checked every fare, closing time and bus rule against official pages before writing this.

🚌 UP BY BUS

Ride the Midosuji Line to Minoh-Kayano (through trains from Namba, Umeda and Shin-Osaka), then Hankyu Bus 30 to Katsuo-ji: about 20 minutes, ¥800.

💳 No cash on that bus since 1 October 2026. Tap an IC card like ICOCA or Suica, and top it up before you board.

🔴 THE DARUMA TEMPLE

Katsuo-ji opens at 8:00 and costs ¥500. Daruma sit on walls, rocks and roofs, left by people who came before an exam or a match.

🌲 DOWN ON FOOT

The Tokai Nature Trail runs about 30 minutes to the Minoh Visitor Center, then about 50 minutes down to the 33 m falls. From there it's about 40 minutes along the river to Hankyu Minoh Station.

🍁 Snack stop: momiji tempura, maple leaves fried in sweet batter, on the falls road.

⏰ The last bus down from Katsuo-ji leaves at 17:05, so the downhill plan also means you never race the clock.

Our take: bus up in the morning, waterfall as the finale, lunch in Minoh.
